name: AI Directory

sources.title: Homepage — 'Database of Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning Companies', table of companies by category/city/country
User submit — WordPress front-end submission form for adding an AI company

requirements: Directory is for AI and machine learning companies, not generic SaaS
Required form fields: Post Title, Category (from fixed list), Company Name, Website address, Phone Number, Email
Optional: Street, City, State, Zip Code, Country, Description
No payment is mentioned anywhere on the submission page
preparation: Category pick from their list (e.g. Agentic AI / AI Agents, SaaS, NLP, Generative AI)
Optional address fields and a short company description
A 'Post Title' — likely the company/product headline shown in the table
workflow: Open https://www.aidirectory.org/user-submit/ (linked as 'SUBMIT YOUR AI COMPANY' in the nav)
Fill the form: post title, category, company name, website, phone, email, optional address/description
Submit and await moderation — the form is a front-end WordPress post submission, so approval is presumably manual
watchFor: Site is dated (footer © 2022; articles last updated 2024) — moderation may be slow or absent
Phone number is a required field — unusual for a directory, decide what number to give
The bare domain aidirectory.org works but the submit form lives on the www subdomain
Listings are displayed in a big table — no dedicated product page implied
No stated review SLA or confirmation flow
countsAsLive: The company appears as a row in the sortable directory table on aidirectory.org under its AI category
unknowns: Whether submissions are still reviewed (site appears lightly maintained)
Whether the website address renders as a dofollow link
